name: The Sparklematic 5200!
summary: In Gnomeregan, the Sparklematic 5200! takes in soiled salvaged objects and cleans them. Its cycles scour away toxic grime, then wrap whatever remains in a gift box.

sections.title: Automated Cleansing
sections.body: Feed toxic and contaminated refuse into the Sparklematic 5200!, and its cycles scour away grime and caustic residue. Once loaded and paid, the machine rattles through its routine. A cheerful ding follows, then a bow-tied present holds whatever remains.

sections.title: Treasure in the Sludge
sections.body: When Gnomeregan fell to the troggs, radiation and industrial mire buried personal effects and scraps of technology. Feed grime-encrusted objects into the machine, and it may recover gemstones, raw ores and other valuables swallowed when the city was vented.

faq.answer: The Sparklematic 5200! cleans objects inside Gnomeregan. Supply a grime-encrusted object and a coin fee, and it scours away sludge, grime and radioactive muck. What remains comes back in a small gift box.
The Sparklematic 5200! is inside the corridors of fallen Gnomeregan, near the Clean Zone where survivors and automated decontamination systems once operated.

faq.q: Why does the machine wrap items in a bow?
faq.answer: Gnomish whimsy gave the Sparklematic 5200! its bow-tied finish. After cleaning fallout and toxic grime from an item, it packages the restored object as a neatly tied present.

faq.q: Can Horde adventurers use the Sparklematic 5200?
faq.answer: Yes. The Sparklematic 5200! is automated and pays no heed to faction allegiance. Insert coins and soiled items, and it runs its cycle.

faq.q: Can I use the Sparklematic multiple times?
faq.answer: Yes. After its first operation, the Sparklematic 5200! can clean items again. Bring grime-encrusted objects found throughout the dungeon to put them through another cycle.
After the first cleaning, you can use the repeatable More Sparklematic Action cycle to clean any additional grime-encrusted finds you carry.

angles.text: As a gnome, the Sparklematic recalls home before the fall. Even an industrial scrub unit chimed cheerfully and wrapped its finished work like a birthday present.
As an engineer, you can study how the Sparklematic cleans particles automatically and packages items quickly, even amid heavy radiation.
